name: qrencode
description: QR Code generator - encode data into QR code symbols and save as PNG images

qrencode.description: Fast and compact QR Code encoding library and command-line utility - supports up to 7000 digits or 4000 characters with high robustness
qrencode.usage:
qrencode -o qr.png 'Hello World'
qrencode -t PNG -o myqr.png 'https://example.com'
echo 'data' | qrencode -o output.png
